sections.headline: Rate Responsive Therapy™ keeps patients saturated — automatically.
sections.copy: Some portable concentrators deliver a fixed volume of oxygen per minute, so the bolus shrinks and FiO₂ drops as a patient breathes faster — forcing the patient to turn the setting up. GCE's Rate Responsive Therapy delivers a constant bolus and automatically responds to the patient's breath rate, so oxygen delivery actually increases with activity instead of decreasing.
checklist: Delivers a constant bolus regardless of breath rate.
Automatically increases oxygen as the patient's demand rises.
Keeps patients saturated even at high breath rates.
No need to change device settings before activity.
Up to 44% more oxygen than some devices at 25 BPM.

sections.headline: A simple retail line that fits next to mobility, footwear, and home medical products.
sections.copy: PediFix gives dealers a practical way to add lower-ticket, high-need footcare items to the showroom. It pairs naturally with shoes, compression, diabetic supplies, braces, mobility products, lift chairs, and daily living aids — building a “Foot Comfort Center” arranged by customer need: toes, bunions, heel, arch, forefoot, skin, fungus, and diabetic footcare.

sections.title: Suggested dealer merchandising strategy
sections.intro: Use this structure to turn PediFix into a simple footcare destination inside your store.
rows: Hammer toe cushions, toe straighteners, toe wraps, toe crutches, separators.

Protect the painful area and separate toes that rub.
Ball-of-foot cushions, metatarsal pads, heel cups, heel sleeves.

Comfort for walking, standing, and daily wear.

Everyday comfort and support add-on next to footwear.
Cleansing bars, soaking crystals, creams, oils, tapes, skin repair items.

Repeat purchase category for ongoing footcare maintenance.
